about: SOQL relationships: parent paths (child-to-parent), subqueries (parent-to-child), semi-joins and anti-joins, on standard and custom objects.

cases.name: parent/a parent field, with the parent's attributes

steps.query: SELECT LastName, Account.Name FROM Contact WHERE Id = '{c1}'

cases.name: parent/an empty lookup is a null parent

steps.query: SELECT LastName, Account.Name FROM Contact WHERE Id = '{c3}'

cases.name: parent/the lookup field and the parent's fields together

steps.query: SELECT AccountId, Account.Id, Account.Name, Account.Tier__c FROM Contact WHERE Id = '{c2}'

cases.name: parent/several levels up

steps.query: SELECT Account.Parent.Name, Account.Owner.Id FROM Contact WHERE Id = '{c1}'
SELECT Name, Parent.Name FROM Account WHERE Id = '{parent}'

cases.name: parent/the owner and audit users

steps.query: SELECT Owner.Id, CreatedBy.Id, LastModifiedBy.Id FROM Account WHERE Id = '{parent}'

cases.name: parent/custom relationships use __r

steps.query: SELECT Name, Account__r.Name, Account__r.Tier__c FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' ORDER BY Name

cases.name: parent/relationship names ignore case

steps.query: SELECT account__R.name FROM Project__c WHERE Id = '{p1}'

cases.name: parent/three levels through custom and standard relationships

steps.query: SELECT Project__r.Account__r.Parent.Name FROM Task_Item__c WHERE Project__c = '{p2}'

cases.name: parent/filtering by parent fields

steps.query: SELECT LastName FROM Contact WHERE Account.Name = '{tag} Child Co' ORDER BY LastName
SELECT LastName FROM Contact WHERE LastName LIKE '{tag}%' AND Account.Parent.Tier__c = 'Gold'
SELECT Name FROM Project__c WHERE Account__r.Tier__c = 'Gold' AND Name LIKE '{tag}%'

cases.name: parent/!= on a parent field matches records without a parent

steps.query: SELECT Name FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Account__r.Tier__c != 'Gold' ORDER BY Name

cases.name: parent/ordering by parent fields

steps.query: SELECT Name FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' ORDER BY Account__r.Name NULLS LAST

cases.name: parent/an empty lookup in a filter

steps.query: SELECT LastName FROM Contact WHERE LastName LIKE '{tag}%' AND AccountId = null

cases.name: parent/an unknown relationship is INVALID_FIELD

steps.query: SELECT Acount.Name FROM Contact
SELECT Account__c.Name FROM Project__c
SELECT Account.Nope FROM Contact

cases.name: children/child records nested under each parent

steps.query: SELECT Name, (SELECT LastName, Email FROM Contacts ORDER BY LastName) FROM Account WHERE Id = '{child}'

cases.name: children/a parent with no children has null, not an empty list

steps.query: SELECT Name, (SELECT Id FROM Contacts) FROM Account WHERE Id = '{parent}'

cases.name: children/WHERE, ORDER BY and LIMIT apply within each parent

steps.query: SELECT (SELECT LastName FROM Contacts WHERE Email != null) FROM Account WHERE Id = '{child}'
SELECT (SELECT LastName FROM Contacts ORDER BY LastName DESC LIMIT 1) FROM Account WHERE Id = '{child}'
SELECT (SELECT LastName FROM Contacts WHERE Email = 'nobody@example.com') FROM Account WHERE Id = '{child}'

cases.name: children/custom child relationships

steps.query: SELECT Name, (SELECT Hours__c, Done__c FROM Task_Items__r ORDER BY Hours__c DESC) FROM Project__c WHERE Id = '{p2}'

cases.name: children/subqueries over several parents, and several subqueries at once

steps.query: SELECT Name, (SELECT LastName FROM Contacts ORDER BY LastName), (SELECT Name, Account__r.Name FROM Projects__r) FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' ORDER BY Name

cases.name: children/the standard self-relationship ChildAccounts

steps.query: SELECT (SELECT Name FROM ChildAccounts) FROM Account WHERE Id = '{parent}'

cases.name: children/a subquery can use parent fields of the child

steps.query: SELECT (SELECT Hours__c, Project__r.Name FROM Task_Items__r WHERE Done__c = true) FROM Project__c WHERE Id = '{p2}'

cases.name: children/an unknown child relationship is INVALID_TYPE

steps.query: SELECT (SELECT Id FROM Contact) FROM Account

cases.name: semi-join/Id IN (SELECT …)

steps.query: SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Id IN (SELECT AccountId FROM Contact WHERE LastName LIKE '{tag}%') AND Name LIKE '{tag}%'

cases.name: semi-join/Id NOT IN (SELECT …)

steps.query: SELECT Name FROM Account WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND Id NOT IN (SELECT AccountId FROM Contact WHERE LastName LIKE '{tag}%')

cases.name: semi-join/on custom objects and fields

steps.query: SELECT Name FROM Project__c WHERE Id IN (SELECT Project__c FROM Task_Item__c WHERE Done__c = true) AND Name LIKE '{tag}%'

cases.name: semi-join/on a reference field rather than Id

steps.query: SELECT LastName FROM Contact WHERE AccountId IN (SELECT Account__c FROM Project__c WHERE Status__c = 'Active' AND Name LIKE '{tag}%') ORDER BY LastName
